description: This file defines a thread-safe JSON storage manager class 'JSONStorage' that provides methods for loading, saving, appending, updating, and filtering JSON data stored in files within a specified directory. It also includes logging for various operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JSONStorage with a cache path and creates the directory if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: _get_file_path
methods.description: Constructs the full file path for a given filename, appending '.json' if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads data from a JSON file, returning a list of dictionaries, with error handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a list of dictionaries to a JSON file with proper formatting and error handling.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends an item to the JSON file, adding metadata such as 'id' and 'created_at'.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing item in the JSON file identified by 'id', adding 'updated_at' metadata.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its 'id' from the JSON file.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters items in the JSON file based on provided key-value criteria.
